purpose: Normalize already-canonical V82/V75 deployment facts into one Canonical Deployment Result and Mentor Return without recomputing investment logic.
required_source_bindings: Work6 exact Funding + Account Isolation result
Work7 exact SGOV Runtime Role result
Work8 exact Protected Holding + Client-action Protection result

normalization_rules.v82: Preserve exact raw V82 execution_action; map transport vocabulary to canonical action only. Protected client action comes from Work8/C Work6-7 and does not rewrite the V82 risk action.
normalization_rules.v75: Preserve exact V75 per-asset and account-scope readiness/gating facts. No sell/reduce semantics are invented; unmapped or reduction/review states become NEEDS_REVIEW while raw source decisions remain attached.
normalization_rules.funding: Copy and cross-bind Work6 AVAILABLE executable budgets only; never derive available cash and never reallocate between equity/bond/account/domain.
normalization_rules.sgov: Preserve Work7 V75_UNDEPLOYED_TO_SGOV contribution as an undeployed disposition; do not compute final dry-powder aggregate or Family physical subledger.
normalization_rules.mentor: Mentor receives source-owned canonical facts and may explain them; Mentor may not mutate actions or recompute V70/V82/V75/C/Funding logic.

fail_closed_bindings: same baseline_id and run_id across Work4/5/6/7/8
same Work3 context handoff across Work4/5/6/7/8
same upstream V70 snapshot/shared context id/shared context digest across Work4 and Work5
Work8 exact Work4 digest and exact canonical V82 digest
Work7 exact Work5 and Work6 digests
Work4 equity budget equals Work6 isolated equity budget
Work5 bond budget equals Work6 isolated bond budget
Work5 Ready snapshot output equals canonical V75 output
Work7 V75 undeployed contribution equals Work5 canonical V75 contribution
Work7 funding evidence equals Work6 cash evidence and Work7 contribution
Work7 SGOV safety assertions remain source-owned constants
